"'''An Examination and Exploration of a Most Dangerous and Resilient Organism'''" was an academic paper written by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Osaf Hamud]] about the little-known [[orbalisk]], a dangerous [[Parasite/Legends|parasite]].<ref name="RT" /> At some point between 993 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] and 983 BBY,<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of the ''[[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy]]'' between [[1003 BBY]] and [[980 BBY]]. Furthermore, ''The Essential Reader's Companion'' establishes that ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] pass between [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] gaining the [[orbalisk armor]] and his attempts to remove it. As [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah's]] mission to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] takes place prior to the removal of the [[orbalisk]]s, the earliest point she could have accessed the document is 993 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. ''The Essential Reader's Companion'' also indicates a ten year gap before the events of ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', meaning the latest she could have accessed the document was 983 BBY.</ref> [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], disguised as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], found the document in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] while searching for a way for her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], to remove the orbalisks [[Orbalisk armor|attached]] to his body. The paper described the medical procedure by which orbalisks could be removed as well as more general information on the parasites.<ref name="RT" />

==Behind the scenes==
"An Examination and Exploration of a Most Dangerous and Resilient Organism" appeared in the novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] and published in [[2007]] as the second installment in the ''[[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy]]''.<ref name="RT" />
